from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CollectionPaper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection, capturing its identity and references to other collection papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this specific paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that this paper explicitly references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[CollectionPaper]
